items.title: AI Stocks Fell, but Workday and Adobe Jumped. A Favorite AI Disruption Trade Just Flinched
items.summary: Software moved against the chip tape on September 14. Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ:WDAY) and Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ:ADBE) rose roughly 2.5% to 3% as chip stocks fell following calls to slow frontier AI development. The market has spent much of the year asking whether stronger models make incumbent software obsolete. A slower frontier suddenly makes the opposite question […]

items.title: HubSpot, ServiceNow, Okta, Workday, and Zscaler Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after shares of enterprise software and SaaS companies rallied broadly as investors rotated capital out of semiconductor and AI-hardware stocks following calls for an artificial intelligence development slowdown.

items.title: Nvidia, Broadcom Tumble In AI Rotation; These U.K.-Based Names Gain
